component: Exchange and Graph folder deletion assertion scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The common helper sets up the supplied mock server and waits for local folder disappearance. Its hard-delete and delete-from-trash callers still assert ewsServer.deletedFolders even when called with graphServer. These assertions therefore do not directly prove Graph remote deletion. The original Graph soft-delete task is disabled; it is enabled in the accepted comparison. No pass, false pass or failure was reproduced.
title: Shared Graph hard-delete tests still assert the EWS deletion log
